project.name: jquantlib (root reactor)
project.description: Repo-root aggregator. Lists jquantlib-parent, which in turn aggregates all four code modules (jquantlib, jquantlib-contrib, jquantlib-helpers, jquantlib-samples). This indirection lets `mvn` invocations from the repo root see the full reactor while preserving the existing `cd jquantlib-parent` workflow. This pom intentionally carries no plugin or dependency config — all build configuration is inherited by each module from jquantlib-parent.
